name: One-Seater Wooden Cushioned Slipper Chair
description: One-seater wooden chair with a polyester cushion that sits low to the ground, perfect for living room or porch areas.

name: Deep-Seat Polyester Arm Chair
description: Low-profile track-arm chair with plush loose back pillows that give comfort and support a good posture.

name: Armless Deep-Seat Polyester Arm Chair
description: Armless deep-seat chair with loose back pillows, comfortable for up to 2 people.

name: Scandinavian-Style Recliner with Ottoman
description: Stressless recliner designed for long periods of sitting and relaxation.

name: Armless Daybed with Movable Backrest
description: A flat, armless upholstered platform elevated on slim metal legs, with weighted, freestanding back cushions featuring top pull loops.

name: High-Back Loveseat Leather PVC
description: A compact two-seat sofa in smooth leather with split high-back cushions and pillowed flare arms.

name: High-Back Loveseat Synthetic Leather
description: Two-seat sofa in smooth synthetic leather, made for ergonomics and comfort.

name: High-Back Stationary Loveseat
description: A compact two-seater sofa upholstered in scratch-resistant synthetic leather (N-Shield), featuring segmented high-back cushioning with integrated head/neck support, low-profile pillow-top arms, and tapered dark legs.

name: Two-Seater Dual Reclining Sofa
description: A full-sized sofa upholstered in charcoal-grey leather or synthetic leather, designed with wide segmented seats, adjustable-pitch headrests, sleek sloped arms, and an integrated metallic power control button on the outer armrest.

name: Three-Seater Power Reclining Sofa
description: A full-length three-seat sofa upholstered in dark brown leather or synthetic leather, featuring high backrests with integrated head/neck cushioning, streamlined track arms, and an integrated electronic button panel on the outer arm.

name: Modern Track-Arm Sofa
description: A full-length three-seater sofa upholstered in reddish-brown leather, defined by clean rectangular lines, slim straight track arms with tailored inner arm pads, three individual seat and back cushions, and elevated black metal stiletto legs.

name: Armless Lounger Sofa
description: Built with an armless, extra-deep bench seat upholstered in scratch-resistant performance fabric (N-Shield Fabric), complemented by large loose back pillows, dual lumbar cushions, and slim black metal legs.

name: Armless Sectional Sofa
description: A modular two-piece sectional upholstered in durable performance fabric (N-Shield Fabric), combining an armless 2-seater bench sofa with an extended chaise lounge. It features deep, flat platform cushions, loose back pillows with matching lumbar supports, and slim, elevated black metal legs.

name: Pullout Sectional Sofa with Storage Chassis
description: A 3-seater L-shaped sectional upholstered in light grey woven fabric, featuring clean track arms, three loose back cushions, and an extended chaise lounge.

name: Nordic Natural Beech Wooden Dining Bench
description: Dining bench featuring a natural solid wood frame with soft, rounded contours. Equipped with a soft, cushioned seat and a removable, machine-washable fabric cover with anti-pilling, stain-resistant, and scratch-resistant processing for easy maintenance.

name: Swivel Wooden Dining Chair with Cushioned Seat
description: Compact swivel dining chair with a wood-look backrest and cushioned seat. It turns easily, so you can change direction without moving the chair. It suits small dining areas and long meals.
material: Beech wood frame with cushioned seat

name: Rubberwood Dining Chair with Wipe-Clean PVC Seat
description: Dining chair with a backrest curved inward to follow the body's contours. The PVC seat wipes clean with water, so it's convenient to maintain for everyday meals.

name: Low Swivel Wooden Dining Chair with Armrests
description: Low-profile swivel chair with armrests that turns from the side, with no need to pull it far from the table. Suited to tight spaces, and the armrests make standing up easy. Seat height is about 39cm, and the armrest edges are shaped in a wavy Japanese modern style.

name: Light Brown Dining Table with Scratch-Resistant Tabletop
description: Four-leg dining table with a 2.4cm thick tabletop and rounded corners. The UV-finished top resists scratches, and the PVC surface wipes clean easily.

name: Dark Brown Solid Beech Wood Four-Leg Dining Table
description: Four-leg dining table with a solid beech wood top and gently rounded edges. The open leg layout lets you sit at the sides. Beech's small spots give each piece its own grain, color and knots.

name: Middle Brown Solid Beech Wood Four-Leg Dining Table
description: Four-leg dining table in a deeper middle brown finish, made with laminated solid beech. The wide top has softly rounded edges, and the four-leg frame keeps the seating spots at the sides free.

name: Dark Brown Wood Grain Four-Leg Dining Table
description: Simple four-leg dining table with a water-resistant melamine top that resists scratches and stains and wipes clean easily. The calm wood grain finish fits living rooms, dining areas and work use.

name: Light Brown Kitchen Counter Cabinet with Drawers and Sliding Table
description: Counter-height kitchen cabinet with three drawers, a door compartment and an open shelf space. The drawers have full-open rails for smooth pull-out, the top and bottom drawers use Hettich-developed undermount rails, and a sliding table suits steam-producing appliances. Standing 85cm high with no top table, it fits small rooms and low ceilings.

name: Middle Brown Oak Veneer Dining Board with Wine Rack and Rattan Door
description: Tall dining storage cabinet with a rattan door, three drawers and a wide open shelf space. The rattan and oil-paint finish give it a natural look. A removable wine bottle rack can be swapped for two shelf boards, and a removable wine glass rack is included. The space under the cabinet is tall enough for a robot vacuum, and the top board gives a narrow ledge for small display items.

name: Light Brown Medium Kitchen Storage Cabinet & Appliance Stand
description: Mid-height kitchen storage board made to house kitchen appliances and pantry items. Features an upper open surface for kitchen electronics, a pull-out sliding tray ideal for microwaves or rice cookers, and enclosed lower storage compartments to organize cookware, dishware, and kitchen supplies.

name: 3-Drawer Wood-Grain Top Plastic Chest
description: Three-drawer plastic chest with a sturdy wood-grain top for books or small items. Light and easy to move, and it assembles in about 15 minutes. Made in Japan.

name: Tall 5-Drawer Tri-Tone Wooden High Chest
description: Tall chest of drawers with fronts in light, middle and dark brown, so it matches almost any room. Every drawer runs on rails, the bottom one on full-slide rails for easy reach, and fold-out legs help keep it from tipping.

name: Low 3-Drawer Chest with Side Door Cabinet
description: Low 68cm chest that pairs three wide slide-rail drawers with a door compartment for small items. Has 10 adjustable shelf heights, a reinforced back panel and a removable anti-tip plate, so it works in both bedrooms and living rooms.

name: Wide 5-Drawer Stackable Storage Chest
description: Wide five-drawer storage case with smooth-closing drawers and slip-out stoppers. Tool-free assembly, holds about 3kg per drawer, and each drawer fits around 8 dress shirts. Made in Japan.

name: Low Tri-Tone Wooden Chest of Drawers
description: Waist-height version of the tri-tone chest with light, middle and dark brown drawer fronts. All drawers glide on rails, the bottom uses full-slide rails, and storable legs add anti-tip support. Delivered assembled.

name: Slim 4-Tier Steel Shoe Rack
description: Slim black steel rack that holds up to 12 pairs of ladies' shoes, with adjustable tiers. Takes about 2kg per shelf and assembles with a Phillips screwdriver.

name: Extendable & Stackable Wooden Shoe Rack
description: Pine-and-steel shoe rack that extends in width and can be stacked to add more tiers. Comes pre-assembled and is light enough to move around easily.

name: Slim Shoe Rack with Wooden Top and Side Hooks
description: Shallow shoe rack made for narrow entryways, with a wooden top for keys or decor and a side bar with two hooks for bags or umbrellas.

name: Ventilated Shoe Cabinet with Adjustable Shelves
description: Low shoe cabinet with a perforated door that lets air in and keeps odors down. Shelves adjust or come out for heels and long boots, and it holds up to 18 pairs.

name: Compact Steel Slipper Rack
description: Small upright steel rack for keeping indoor slippers neat by the door or bedroom. Powder-coated body with rubber caps, comes assembled and weighs under 1kg.

name: Wide Steel Open Closet with Hanger Rail and Shelves
description: Large open-style steel closet system with a hanging rail and shelves for clothes, bags and storage boxes. Its 220cm width makes it a full walk-up wardrobe without doors.

name: Tall Multi-Purpose Wardrobe Cabinet
description: Full-height wardrobe cabinet in a whitewash finish for hanging clothes and storing folded items behind doors.

name: Natural Pine Wood Open Wardrobe
description: Tall open wardrobe made of natural pine with a hanging rail for clothes and space for folded items. Light at under 10kg and takes about 40 minutes to assemble.

name: Extendable Double-Bar Hanger Rack
description: Steel hanger rack with two bars that stretches in both width (90-139cm) and height (95.5-169cm), so it fits long coats and dresses. Holds up to 25kg and pairs with storage boxes sold separately.

name: Extendable Single-Bar Hanger Rack
description: Single-bar version of the extendable hanger rack that adjusts in width and height for long clothes. A simple open-closet option for small rooms, with space below for storage boxes.
